style.prompt:
Design a polished vertical night market event flyer, aspect ratio 9:16. Midnight navy background, warm amber lanterns, subtle coral and golden accents, tasteful illustrated market stalls and string lights framing the edges. Strong clean editorial typography with excellent legibility. The flyer must contain EXACTLY FOUR SEPARATE TEXT BLOCKS in this precise top-to-bottom order, with generous clear empty space between each block. Render the following text exactly, without quotation marks:
Block 1: NIGHT MARKET
Block 2: 18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00
Block 3: Old Mill Courtyard
Block 4: Free entry • Everyone welcome
Keep each block visually distinct and centered. Headline largest, remaining text clearly readable. No other words, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, stall labels or signage. Keep illustrations away from the text. Preserve the exact punctuation, date, en dash and bullet.
